The '''Sandhawk''' was an [[Bird/Legends|avian]] creature [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was often [[Hunting/Legends|hunted]] for its savory meat.<ref name="GG7" />
